Dual Command System:
o Under the dual command system, the District Magistrate and the Superintendent of Police (SP) share powers and responsibilities in a district.
o Under this structure, the DM is entrusted with issuing arrest warrants, licenses while the SP has powers and responsibilities to investigate crime and make arrests.
o The system is designed to ensure a lower concentration of power and making the police more accountable to the DM at the district level.
• Commissionerate System:
o Under the police commissionerate system, the powers of both policing and magistracy are concentrated with the commissioner, who is directly accountable to the state government and the
state police chief.

o The commissioner of police under the commissionerate system exercises the powers and duties of a District Magistrate. The office also has magisterial powers, including those related to regulation, control, and licensing. These powers are also available to any officer under the commissioner who is not below the rank of an Assistant Commissioner of Police.

Primary Productivity : Per unit area me koi given time me, kitna amount of Biomass ya Organic matter produce hua hai, by plants during photosynthesis.
- Weight (gm/m2) ya Energy(kcal/m2) me express karte hain---> Or, different ecosystems ki productivity naapne me kaam aata hai.
- Gross Primary Productivity : Rate of Production of organic Matter during photosynthesis.
Ye depend karti hai, plant species par, jo particular area me rehte hain.
Ye environmental factors par bhi depend karti hai, jaise ki nutrients and photosynthetic capacity of plants.
- Betichod, agar isme se, Respiration losses ko hata do, to Net Primary Productivity milti hai.
Ye, wo biomass hota hai, jo Heterotrophs(Herbivores and decomposers) ko available hota hai, consumption ke liye.
- Secondary Productivity : Rate of formation of new organic matter by consumers.
Decomposers log--> Dead organic praanio ko , inorganic Substances me convert kar dete hain.
- Iske steps hote hain : Fragmentation, Leaching, Catabolism, Humification and Mineralisation. ---> Ye saare steps, simultaneously ho rahe hote hain.
Detritivores (Ex: Earthworms) :---> Breaks down, detritus into smaller particles. --> Yahi to hai, fragmentation.
Bacteria and Fungus log, detritus ko, simpler inorganic substances me degrade kar dete hain---> Yahi to hai, Catabolism.
Soil me decomposition ke time, Humification and Mineralisation hota hai.
Humification se, Humus naam ka dark colored, amorphous substance banta hai, jo microbial action ke highly resistant hota hai.
Humus, bohot slowly decompose hota hai.
Colloidal hone ki wajah se---> Serves as a reservoir of nutrients.
Humus ko kuch chutiye microbes, further degrade kar dete hain----> Is se inorganic nutrients release hote hain ---> Yahi to hai, mineralisation.
Overall, decomposition is an oxygen-requiring process.
Decomposition slow ho jata hai, agar, detritus is rich in lignin and chitin.
Decomposition fast ho jata hai, agar, detritus is rich in nitrogen and water-soluble substances like sugars.
Warm and moist environment ==> Favour Decomposition
Low Temperature and Anaerobiosis ==> Inhibits decompositon ----> Resulting in buildup of organic materials.
Terrestrial ecosystems me----> Much larger fraction of energy flows throug detritus food chain than through Grazing food chain.

Standing crop : Har trophic level par, ek certain mass of living material hote hain, jinhe standing crop kehte hain.

Pyramis of Biomass : Indicates the toal mass of organims at each trophic level.
- Ye usually, bottom par largest hota hai lekin hamesha nahi.
- Calculated by multiplying the number of individuals in the trophic level by average mass of one individual in a particular area.
- More accurate representation of energy contnet of 1 trophic level, as compared to Pyramid of numbers.
- Lekin, sala iske bhi limitations hain ":
Different species ke different breeding seasons hote hain.
Or betichod, har janwar ka wajan lene tera baap jayega.
- Sea me, Pyramid of Biomass inverted hota hai(generally), kyunki, biomass of fishes far exceeds that of phytoplankton.          Terrestrial wale me upright, kyunki ped bohot bhari hota hai.
Pyramid of Productivity : Looks at energy content as well as the Loss of energy between trophic levels.
- Ye baaki dono se jyada accurate hota hai.
- Lindeman's Ten Percent Law par based hai. ---> Only 10% of the energy in a trophic level will go towards creating biomass (Tissues, muscles, stems, leaves etc) in the next trophic level.
- It is always upright.
Stratification : Species ke vertical distribution ko bolte hain, jo different levels occupy karti hain.

REER : Real Effective Exchange Rate
- Desh ki currency ka weighted average, in relation to an (index) or (basket of other major currencies).
- Desh ke saath trade balance ke hisab se currency ko weights assign kiye jaate hain.
- Matlab, Avg of bilateral exchange rates between itself and its trading partnetrs and then weighing it using the trade allocation of each partner.
- Kisi desh ki Trade capabilites naapme me effective hota hai.
NEER : Nominal Effective exchange Rate
- Unadjusted weighted average rate at which one country's currency exchanges for a basket of multiple foreign currencies.
- NER is the amount of domestic currency needed to purchase foreign currency.
- Indicator of country's international competitiveness in terms of foreign exchange market.
- Forex traders refer to NEER as the trade-weighted currency index.
- May be adjusted to compensate for the inflation rate of home country relative to the inflation rate of its trading partners.

Trade Agreements :
1) Preferential Trade Agreements (PTAs) : 2 ya jyada partners---> Agree to reduce tariffs on agreed number of tariff lines.
- List of products, jinpar partners agree to reduce duty is called--> Positive list.
- Ex : India- MERCOSUR PTA
- Generaly, PTSs do not cover cover, substantially all trade.
2) FTAs : Substantial bilateral trade wale items par, tariffs eliminate kar diya jata hai.
- Each maintian individual tariff structure for non-members.
- Ex : India-Sri-Lanka FTA
- PTA me ek positive list hoti hai, jispar duty kam ki jaati hai, lekin FTA me ek negative list hoti hai, jispar duty eliminate ki jati hai.
- Compared to PTA, FTAs---> Generally jyada ambitious hote hain, in coverage of tariff lines(Products) on which duty is to be reduced.
3) CECA and CEPA : Integrated package on goods, services and investments along with other areas including IPR, competition etc.
- Ex : India-Korea CEPA.
- Trade facilitation,  Customs cooperation,  Investment,  Competition, IPR etc
4) Custom Union : Partner desh--> May decide to trade at zero duty among themselves---> But they maintain common tariffs against rest of the world.
- Ex : EU and South African Customs Union(SACU) : South Africa,   Lesotho,   Namibia,  Botswana  and  Swaziland.
5) Common Market : Customs Union + Free movement of labour and Capital,  Harmonize tech standards across members, etc.
- Ex : EU
6) Economic Union :  Common Market + Further harmonization of fiscal/monetary policies and shared executive, judicial and legislative institutions.
- Ex : EU

'Countdown to 2023' : WHO ki report hai---> Global trans-fat elimiation by 2023.
- Trans-Fats : a.k.a Partially Hydrogenated oils
1) Liquid Vegetable oil par, hydrogen add karne se milte hain.
2) Is se, shelf life badh jati hai, and make them more suitable for frying and other uses.
3) Bad cholesterol(LDL) ko badhate hain, or good wale ko kam karte hain.
4) Good Cholesterol : High-Density lipoproteins ---> Pich up excess cholesterol and transport it back to body's liver for processing.
4) Bad Cholesterol : Ye, cholesterol ko puri body me transport karte hain---> Body ki arteries me bind up ho jata hai, reducing blood flow, increases chances of Heart attack and stroke.
- Matlab, veggie oil ko harden karne se Trans fats bante hain.  Jitna solid fat---> More trans fats it contains
- NAturally occuring trans fats : Ruminants me milte hain, jaise cows and sheeps.
- Indsutrially produced : Hardened veggie fats such as margarine ---> Present in snack foods, baked goods and fried foods.
- India me har saal 60,000 log, inki wajah se marte hain.
- WHO ka REPLACE action framework==> Eliminate industrially produced trans fats from food supplies. ----> TOtal energy intake ke 1% se kam karna hai.

2) Arctic Sea Ice ---> Massive losses
3) Artlantic Circulation ---> 1550s se slowdown ho raha hai
4) Boreal Forests---> Fires
5) Coral Reefs ---> Mass Die-off
6) Greenland ice-sheets ---> Ice loss accelerate ho raha hai.
7) Permafrost ---> MElt ho raha hai.
8) West Antarctic Ice sheet ---> Ice loss accelerate ho raha hai.
9) Wilkes Basin ----> East Antarctica ka ice bhi loss ho raha hai.

Vaccine banane ke 3 tareeke :
1) Pura ka pura, Virus ya bacteria hi ghused do
- Ise bhi 3 tarah se banaya ja sakta hai :
i) Inactivated vaccine(killing it with heat, chemicals etc)
- Flu  and  Polio vaccines is se banti hai.
- Virus or Bacteria grow karne ke liye special lab facilites chahiye hoti hai. ----> Long Production time.
- 2 ya 3 dose chahiye hoti hai, admin karne ke liye.
ii) Live-Attenuated vaccine(jinda but weakend)
- Measles,  Mumps or Rubella (MMR) vaccine ,    Chickenpox and shingles vaccine isi se banti hai.
- Compromised immune system walo ko ye vaccine maa chod sakti hai.
iii) Viral Vector Vaccine : Safe virus ki madad se specific sub-parts , jaise ki proteins- of the germ of interest ko deliver karte hain
- Can trigger immune respone without causing disease
- Ebola vaccine
- Ise, rapidly develop kiya ja sakta hai.
2) Bas, Genetic Material ghusedo
3) Bas unhi parts ko ghusedo, jo immune response trigger karte hain.
DNA and RNA ---> Nucleic Acid vaccines hote hain---> Gene-Based vaccines.
- Immune response se anti-bodies produce hoti hain---> Jo hame aage bachati hain.
- DNA pehle, Messanger RNA me convert hota hai----> Ye as a blueprint use hota hai----> To make specific protein, jo Human bodies ke andar ek immune response trigger karta hai.
- DNA vaccine me, DNA ka ek piece(encoding the antigen) ---> 1st inserted into a bacterial plasmid.
- Plasmid---> Ek chota sa, circular DNA molecule hota hai, jo Bacteria ya dusri cells me milta hai.
- Inme thode se hi genes hote hain, jo generally, koi antibiotic resistance se associated hote hain.
- DNA plasmids(jo antigen carry kar rahe hain)----> Ko muscles me inject kiya jata hai, jis se fir ye cells me chale jaate hain---> Using tech such as "Electroporation".
- RNA vaccines se, Antigen of interest, mRNA me encode hota hai.
- RNA ko directly ghused sakte hain, ya fir,nanoparticles ke saath(Jaise Pfizer ki mRNA based Covid vaccine)
- mRNA ke ulat, DNA wali vaccines, ko ultra-cold storage systems nahi chahiye hote, or ye jyada cost effective bhi hoti hain.
Nucleic Acid Vaccines ke fayde :
1) Ye safe or non-infectious hoti hain, kyunki ye koi pathogen particles nahi hota.
2) Traditional vaccines se strong immune response
3) Jyada rapidly produce kar sakte hain.

Coral Bleaching : Wo process jisme, corals white ho jate hain, kai saare stresses ki wajah se, jaise changes in temperatures, light or nutrients.
- Coral Polyps, zooxanthellae(Ek tarah ka algae) ko expell kar dete hain.   Ye saali algae, unke tissues ke andar rehti hai.
- Coral, zooxanthellae ko ghar ke saath saath, Co2 or Ammonium bhi deta hai, jo photosynthesis ke liye jaruri hota hai.
- Zooxanthellar photosynthetic hoti hain, or jaise jaise pani ka temperature badhta hai, ye reactive oxygen species banana shuru kar deti hain.
- Ye coral ke liye toxic hota hai. Isliye, coral gand par laat maar kar, zooxanthellae ko Tata-Byebye bol deta hai.
- Kyunki, zooxanthelae hi jyadatar coral pigment banati hain, isliye, unke chale jane se, coral feeka pad jata hai. ---> Bas calcium carbonate se bana skeleton hi bachta hai.
- Saare bleached corals white nahi hote, kuch pink bhi hote hain.
- Bleached coral---> Ye vulnerable hote hain disease or starvation ke.     90% energy, zooxanthellae se milti thi coral ko.
- Jyadatar bechare bhuke mar jaate hain.
- Coral reef, 25% of marine life ko shelter provide karte hain.
- Leading cause hai--> Rising water temperatures.    BC, bas 1 degree rise se bleaching ho jati hai.
- Great barrier reef ki maa chud rahi hai.

Protein Folding
- Amino Acids ke merger se jo proteins bante hain, unme 10 raised to the power 150 tak, type ke folded structures mil sakte hain.
- To ye pata lagana bohot mushkil hota hai ki, protein fold kaisa dikhega.

- Oh, ALS disease, Madcow disease etc, ghatiya protein folding ki wajah se hi hoti hai.
- Now back to the competition.   Isme, jitna close prediction hai, real structure ke, uske basis se, out of 100% score kiya jata hai, teams ko.
- Generally teams ko 10-20% tak mil paat tha.
- Lekin, last 2 saalo me,  Google ki AI company Deep Mind, ne 90% score kiya hai.
- To is se, Protein folding predict karna bohot easy ho gaya hai.
- Lekin, AI ko bhi data chahiye, predict karne ke liye. Jin proteins ke liye data nahi hai, unke structures determine nahi kiye jaa sakte.
- Lekin, is AI ki wajah se, scientist log, khudke protein structrues bana sakte hain, jis se Cancer jaise bimari se lada jaa sakta hai.

Neutron Stars :
- Ek supergiant star(JO apne sun se 10 ya 25 guna jyada mass ka hota hai) ki collapsed core hoti hai ye.
- Ye bhayanak chote, or bhayanak bhaari hote hain.
- Inki radius bas 10 km ke aaspass hoti hai. ----> Inka Mass, Sun ke dedh dhai guna tak hota hai.
- Jab, Massive Stars, Supernova explosion me shaheed ho jaate hain + Gravitational Collapse ===>> Core compress hokar, White Dwarf se bhi jyada choti ho jati hai.
- AIsa hone ke baad, ye heat generate nahi karte---> Time ke saath Saath thande hote rehte hain.
- Ye entirely Neutron se milke bane hote hain---> Electrons or Protons combine hoke, Neutron bana dete hain.
- Inhe Further collapse hone se, Neutron Degeneracy pressure bachaata hai.  [White dwarfs ko further collapse hone se, Electron degeneracy pressure bachata hai]
- Lekin, agar, iska mass 2 solar masses se jyada hota hai, to ye pressure + repulisve force bhi hold nahi kar paati, collapse hone se, or betichod ka, Black hole ban jata hai.
- Ye bhayanak garam hote hai---> Surface temperatures---> 6 lakh kelvin.
- Inki Magnetic Field earth se 10 raised to the power 15 guna tak strong ho sakti hai.
- Jab star collapse hone lagta hai, tab uski rotation speed badh jaati hai, to ye saala har second me kai 100 baar ghumta hai.
- Is wajah se betichod, kuch Neutron starts, EM radiation ke beams emit karte hain----> Pulsars.
- Akele Milkey way galaxy me 1 billion Neutron Stars hain.

RetroVirus :
1) Ye ek aisa virus hota hai, jo apne RNA genome ki ek copy, host cell ke DNA me insert kar deta hai.
2) Is se, Host Cell ka genome hi change ho jata hai.
3) Ye Host cell ke cytoplasm me jata hai, or khudka Reverse Transcriptase enzyme use kar, DNA banane lagta hai, from it's RNA genome-------> Jo normally hota hai, uska ulta--> Isiliye, RETRO.
4) Fir ye wala DNA jake wo, host cell ke genome me insert kar deta hai, using Integrase enzyme. ----> Ab retroviral DNA ko ProVirus kehte hain.
5) Fir bechari cell, use viral DNA ko bhi apne hi Genome ka hissa samjhke, viral genese ko bhi transcribe or translate karne lagti hai, along with cell's own genes.
6) Is se jo proteins bante hain, unse Virus ki nayi copies banai jati hai.
7) Ex : HIV,  Human T-lymphotropic virus(HTLV),   Murine Leukemia virus--> Ye undar jaati me cancer kar deta hai.
8) Lekin, inka use, Gene Delivery systems ke tor par bhi kiya jata hai.

Demand Pull Inflation :
1) Jab, aggregate demand for a good or service, aggreagate supply se aage nikal jaati hai.
2) Jab, aggregate demand, productive capacity se jyada teji se badhti hai, tab, firms, prices badha deti hain. ---> Is se inflation hota hai.
3) Ye sabse, common cause hai, Inflation ka.
4) Causes :
1) Growing Economy
2) Lower Interst Rates
3) Devaluation in the exchange rate---> Is se domestic demand badh, jaati hai, kyunki imports mahange ho jaate hain.  Is se, Cost-push inflation bhi aata hai, kyunki, imports mahange ho jaate hain.
4) Government Spending
5) More money in the system : Expansionary monetary policy.

Plasma -  4th state of Matter
1) Gas jaisa hai, lekin comprised of Positive ions and free electrons ---> With little or no overall electric charge
2) Charged ions ki presence ki wajah se, Plasma highly electrically conductive hota hai, or kafi strongly respond karta hai, magnetic or electric fields ke.
3) Plasma ki koi fixed shape or volume nahi hota, or wo solids/liquids se less dense hota hai.
4) Plasma, most common state hai matter ka, in Universe---> Comprising more than 99% of our visible universe.
5) Ye sub ne naturally milta hai,   Stars ki cores me,    Pulsars jo X-Ray beams emit karte hain or Supernovas me.
6) Earth par, Flames, Lightning or auroras me milta hai.
7) High Temp par gas ko heat karne se , gas ke atoms, ionize ho jate hain.

RT-PCR :
Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction
1) Ye Covid-19 Sars virus ko identify karne ke liye.
2) Naak me rui daal ke Virus ke nucleic acid ko detect karte hain.
3) Chutiyaap :
a) Temperature ka randi rona---> 2 alag alag temperatures chahiye---> Iske liye, Mahnage Thermal Cycler or Real time PCR machines chahiye.
b) Deep freezer chahiye, sample ko store karne ke liye.
c) Use karne ke liye, extensive treaining deni padti hai
d) 95% sppecificity and sensitivity---> Matlab false negative bhi aa jaate hain.
e) 10 ghante lagte hain, result dikhane me.   Remote areas me to or bhi jyada
RT- LAMP :
Reverse Transcription Loop Mediated isothermal amplifiation
1) ye bhi SARS-CoV-2 ko detect karne ke liye, use ho raha hai India me
2) Isme RNA se pehle cDNA banate hain, by ususal Reverse transcription ----> Fir DNA ko amplify karte hain by LAMP technology.
3) ADvantages:
a) Cost-effective hai----> Airport wagarh par, mobile units wagarh me setup kiya ja sakta hai.
b) Ye 65 Degrees par karwaya jaata hai----> DNA amplification ko constant temperature par karwaya jaata hai---> Isliye, expansive Thermal Cycler nahi chahiye hota hai.
c) Final DNA amplify hokar aata hai jo, wo kaafi jyada hota hai, isliye, simple color reaction se hi kaam chal jaata hai---> Koi mahangi Real time PCR machine nahi chahiye
d) Reagents ko 4 degreees par store karna hota hai, Yaani lalu se fridge me hi rakh lo chahe to, RT-PCR wale ko -20 degrees me.
e) Or sabse mast baat--> Bas 30 minutes me result aa jaata hai---> or agar positive ho to saala bas 10 minutes me .
IN-SITU BIO-Remeditation Techniques :
1) BIOVENTING :- Contaminated soil me, kue khod ke, Air or nutrients supply karo---> Taaki waha indegenous bacteria grow ho sake.
- Ise simple Hydrocarbons ke liye use kiya jata hai.
- Agar, contamination surface ke kaafi neeche ho, to bhi use kiya ja sakt hai.
2) BioSPARGING :- Khub pressure me, Water Table ke neeche, Air Inject karo, taaki groundwater oxygen concentration badh sake.
- Is se contaminants jis rate me biological degradation karte hain, usa rate badh jata hai
3) Bioslurping :- Bioventing + Vaccum-enhanced free product recovery ki madad se---> 2 seperate contaminant media ko address kiya jata hai.
- Bioventing---> Stimulates aerobic bioremediation of Hydrocarbon-contaminated soils.
- Vaccum-Enhanced......Recovery se---> Water table se capillary action ki madad se groundwater contaminants extract kar lete hain.
4) BioAugmentaion :- Contaminated sites me micro-organisms ko import kiya jata hai, to enhance the degradation process.
EX-SITU Bioremediation :
1) Landfarming : Contaminated soil ko excavate kare, ek prepared bed par spreak kar dete hain or periodically till karte hain.
- Goal = Stimulate Indigenous biodegradative microorganisms
- Facilitate aerobic degradation of contaminants.
2) Biopiles : Hybrid of landfarming and composting.---- Petroleum se contamination par use kiya jata hai
3) Bioreactors :- Contaminated solid material ko engineered conatinment system ke through process kiya jata hai.

DRAINAGE PATTERNS :
1) Dendritic :-
- Jab, terrain ke slope ko follow kare river
- Stream, apni tributaries ke saath, Ped ki branches jaisi lagti hai.
- Jyadatar rivers of Indo-Gangetic Plains---> Dendritic Type
2) Trllis :-
- Jab, tributaries, Rivers se right angles pe aakar jude.
- Ye develop hota hai, jab har or soft rocks, parallel ho ek dusre ke.
- Trellis me, river ek net-like system form karti hai.
- Tributaries, roughly flow parallel to each other.
- Chotanagpur plateau ke purane fold mountains me trellis pattern wale drainage dekhne ko milta hai.
3) Rectangular :-
-  Nashedi Trellis---> more irregular and tributaries are not as long, nor parallel as in trellis drainage.
- Strongly jointed rocky terrain me dikhta hia.
- Vindhyan Mountains of India
4) Radial Pattern :-
- Central Peak or dome-like structure se jab, different directions me stream flow karti hai.
- Amarkantak Mountain se jo nadiya nikatli hai.
- Ex :- Rivers like, narmada, Son and Mahanadi, orginiating from Amarkantak hills flow in different directions.
- Ye same pattern, Girnar hills (Kathiawar, Gujrat) and Mikir Hills of Assam  me dikhta hai.

Zones of Lakes and Ponds :
1) Littoral ZOne :-  Topmost zone near the shore of a lake or pond is Littoral Zone.
Ye zone warmest hota hai---> Since it is shallow and absorb more of sun's heat.
Ye fairly diverse community ko sustain kar sakta hai----> Several species of Algae(Like diatoms), rooted and floating aquatic plants, Grazing snails, Clams, Insects, Crustaceans, fishes etc
2) Limnetic Zone :-  Near-Surface, open water surrounded by Littoral zone
Ye open water area hota hai, jaha light does not penetrate to the bottom.
Ye bhi, littoral zone ki tarah, well lighted hota hai---> Dominated by Plankton--> Both Phytoplankton and Zooplantkton
Yaha bohot tarah ke freshwater machii bhi milti hai.
3) Profundal Zone :-  Lake/Pond ka deep water
Ye zone,kaafi cold or dense hota hai, baaki dono se.
Yaha bohot hi thodi light pahonchti hai.
Yaha ka fauna heterotrophs hota hai, jo mare hue organisms ko khata hai, and use oxygen for cellular respiration.

2) Late Devonian Extinction- 350 million years ago-----------> Ocean ka oxygen level kam ho gaya or Squid or octopus ke dada saans liye bina mar gaye, bhen ke lode.
3) Permian Triassic extinction - 250 million years ago-------> Siberain traps se lava nikla or jal gaye bhen ke lode.
4) Triassic-Jurassic Extinction- 200 million years ago-------> Central Pangea se greenhouse gases nikli, or greenhouse effect ki wajah se mar haye mahan ke lode.
5) Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction- 66 million years ago-----> Asteroid aake takraya or lode lag gaye.

COST-PUSH INFLATION:
1) Cost of wages or raw materials ke cost, badhne se jo inflation aata hai.
2) Higher cost of production se aggregate supply(amount of total production), kam ho sakti hai.
3) Kyunki, demand same rehta hai, isliye, Price increases from production are passed onto consumers creating, cost-push inflation.
4) Cost-push inflation hota hai, jab, Supply cost badhta hai, or supply levels gir jaate hain.  Dono se hi prices badh jayenge, as long as demand remains same.
5) Labour, Raw materials ya capital goods me shortages ya cost increase se, cost-push inflation aata hai.
6) Ye bas tabhi aa sakta hai, jab demand relatively inelastic ho.
- Inelastic demand bole to---> Jaise, Cocaine wagarh ki hoti hai----> Matlab, price badhne par bhi log, chutiyo ki tarah khareed te hain.
- Iske ulat, Elastic demand hoti hai---> Jab log, higher price pay karne se mana kar de.
- WO yaa to kam khareed dari karte hain, ya fir wo slightly different product ko switch kar dete hain.

India ka 3 stage nuclear Programme:
- Stage I : Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR)
- Natural Uranium Oxide ka use kar bijli banana, jis se Plutonium-239 byproduct  milega.
- Moderator or coolant dono ka kaam karta hai heavy water.
- Is puri tech par India is self-reliant.
- Stage II : Fast Breeder Reactors ----> Second Stage of Nuclear power generation
- FBR wo reactors hote hain, jinme fast neutrons ka use kar, jitna fule consume kiya jata hai, us se jyada generate kar liya jata hai.
- 1st stage se jo Pu-239 mila tha, uska use karte hain.
- FBR ke fuel core me, U-238 ka ek blanket, core ke chaaro or hota hai, jo nuclear transmutaion se Fresh Pu-239 produce karta hai, jabki saath saath Pu-239 consume ho raha hota hai.
- FBR core me, thoda sa Th-232 bhi rakh dete hain, jo Neutron capture karta hai, or U-233 ban jata hai.
- Ye U-233, fir 3rd stage me use hoga.
- FRB ko Fast breeder isliye bolte hain, kyunki Moderator nahi use karta hai
- Yaha coolant ke liye, Liquid Sodium use hota hai.
- India ka 1st prototype Fast Breeder Reactor ek, 500 MWe ka FBR hai, jise Kapakkam me Madras Atomic Power Station me banaya ja raha hai.
- Stage III : Advance Nuclear power system--> Self sustaining series of Thorium-232-Uranium-233 fuelled reactors hote hain.
- 2nd Stage me jo U-233 obtained hota hai, use as a fuel use kiya jata hai.
- U-233 ke alawa, Th-232 ki ek blanket bhi hoga, U-233 reactor core ke arround, jis se reactor ke operational hone se U-233 milega.
- Matlab, more and more U-233 fuel will be produced from the Th-232 blanket as more of the U-233 in the fuel core is consumed----> Is se long term fuel requirement sustain ho payegi.

Weak Vortex ke time, thandi hawayein, mid-latitudes(jaha burgers rehte hain) tak bhi pahonch jaati hai.

Bond Yield:
i) Bond agar, higher value pe trade kar raha ho, apni face value se, to ham kehte hain ki Bond is trading at a premium.
Is case me----> Bond ki yield, Coupon rate se kam ho jati hai.
ii)  Bond agar, apni face value se kam pe trade kar raha ho, to we say, Bond is trading at a discount.
Is case me-----> Bond ki yield, Coupon se jyada ho jati hai.
Kul milake---> As Bond Price Increase ===> Bond Yield Decrease
Interest rates ka bhi Bond Yield pe affect padta hai.
i) Agar Market rate, coupon rate se jyada hai---> To Investors will not find the bonds attractive====> Jis se Bond ka price decrease ho jayega----> Bond Yield Badh jayegi.
ii) Agar Market rate kam hai, coupon rate se to--> To Investor log ko James Bond kaafi attractive lagega===> Jis se Bond ke price badh jayenge-----> Bond Yield Kam ho jayegi.
Jab Bond Yields jyada hoti hai---> Tab Stock market kam sexy lagta hai.

Maden-Julian Osscilation--> Band of low pressure areas(Bw 30N-30S) which moves from west to east; Detemines initiation and intensities of low-pressure areas/Depression/cyclones/Monsoons.
MJO influences the ENSO cycle. It does not cause El Nino or La Nina, but can contribute to the speed of development and intensity of El Nino and La Nina episodes.
When MJO is over the Indian Ocean during the Monsoon season, it generally brings good rainfall over the Indian subcontinent.
Indian Ocean Dipole (IOD)
o It is also referred to as the Indian Niño, is a condition when the SST of the western region of Indian Ocean alternately becomes abnormally colder and then abnormally hotter than the
eastern region.
o The Indian Niño can neutralise or worsen the impact of El Niño/La Niña depending on which phase it is in.
o A ‘positive’ IOD phase, which means higher-than-usual temperatures in the western Indian Ocean, brings more rain to India than the ‘neutral’ or ‘negative’ (cooling) phase.

g) Central Government to be headed by Governor General, jise British Government appoint karegi, lekin use Indian Revenues se pay kiya jayega.
Ye central Executive council ke advice pe kaam karega, jo Responsible hoga Parliament ke.
h) Provincial Councils ka 5-year tenure hoga.  Inhe Governor head karega, on the advice of Provincial Executive council
i) Mulle ke cultural and Religious interests ko full protection diya jayega
j) Complete dissociation of State from Religion.

Government of India act, 1935
1) All India Federation
2) Centre me Dyarchy-> Reserved or Transferred subject
3) Central Legislature:   Upper house (Council of States- 260 members), and Lower house ( Federal Assembly- 375 members)
CoS--> Partly elected from British Indian provinces and 40% nominated by the princes.
FA---> Partly indirectly elected from British Indian Provinces and 33% nominated by the princes.
(BC, kya chutiyaap hai---> Council of States ke election direct hain, or Fereal Assembly ke indirect)
4) CoS--> Permanent body, 1/3rd members retiring every 3rd year.     FA---> 5 year duration
5) Federal, Provincial and Concurrent lists.
6) FA ke members, Ministers ke against no-confidence motion pass kar sakte the.
7) Reliion or Caste based electorated ke system ko or bhi extend kar diya gaya.
8) 80% of budget, votable tha.

10) GG ke pass veto or ordinance powers bhi thi,or , ye saala chahta toGrants me cuts ko restore kar sakta tha,or Legislature ne agar bills ko reject kiya ho, to bhi unhe cerify kar sakta tha.
11) Provinces se Dyarchy wala randaap khatam ho gaya, or Provincial Autonomy de di gayi.
12) Provinces ki legal assistance Secy of State or GG se hatakar, seedhe British Crown ke haatho me de di gayi.
13) Governor, direct crown ka representative tha.
14) Legislature ke saare members, directly elected the.    Aurato ko voting ka adheekar de diya gaya.
15) Responsible Ministers.
16) 40 % of budget, abhi bhi non-votable tha.
17) Governor chahta to Bill ko assent dene se mana kar sakta tha, Ordinace promulgate kar sakta tha,     Governor's act enact kar sakta tha.

Constitutional, Administrative and Judicial Developments
Consti. Developments between 1773 and 1858 :
- Battle of Buxar(1764) ke baad, EIC ko Diwani mil gayi, thi Bengal, Bihar and Orissa ki.
- Mughal Emperor Shah Alum II ko annual subsidy di jaani thi, or Nawab of Awad, Shujadi-Dalle-ki, ko bhi annual pension milne lagi thi
- Company ne 2 deputy dewans appoint kiye - Bengal ke liye, Mohammad Peza Reza Khan   or     Bihar ke liye, Raja Shit-Ab Raj
- 1767 me Pehli baar EIC ne Indian Affairs me intervene kiya, jab isne 10% share manga, loot maar me---> Jo saala 40 lakh pound banta tha har saal ka.
- 1765 se 1772  tak, Dual System of Gov chalta raha, Jaha EIC ke pass authority thi, lekin koi responsibility nahi thi, or Indian chodo ke pass responsibility thi, lekin koi authority nahi thi.
i) Comany ke servant bhayanak corruption kiya karte the----> Private trading kar, khub dhan kamaya, or saar paisa Bitcoin me invest kar diya.
ii) Peasants ke lode lag gaye, kyunki unse excessive revenue collection kiya jane laga.
iii) Company bankrupt ho rahi thi, lekin servants ke stock hawa me the.
- Ye sab  se British gov was like, Dude, WTF is going on, so they decided to regulate the company affairs---> taki business me kuch order aa sake.
Regulating Act of 1773 :
1) Ye pehla act the, jis se British gov ne Indian affairs me mut-peshab karna shuru kiya----> To control and regulate the functioning of EIC.

2) Isne recognise kiya ki EIC ke chode, bas trade nahi kar rahe, balki Administrative or Political fields me bhi gand marwa rahe hain, Isliye, is act se Element of Centralised Administration introduce kiya gaya.
3) Company ke directors ko bola ki, apni saari correspondences regarding, Revenue affairs and civil and military admin, submit karo Governemt ko.
(Matlab, pehli baar, British Cabinet ko right diya gaya, to exercise control over Indian Affairs)
4) Bengal me admin, ke liye Governor-General hoga or ek 4 members ki council hogi, jisme civil or military government ke representatives honge.
5) Inhe Majority rule ke hisab se function karna hoga.    Warren Hastings or 4 baaki chodo ka naam diya gaya is Act me.   Future me company appoint karegi ye chode.
6) Bengal me ek Supreme Court of judicature banai jayegi, Jiske pass original and appellate jurisdictions hongi, jaha sab subjects, redressal ke lie tareekh pe tareekh mang sakte hain.
7) GG, ke paas thodi powers hongi, Bomaby or Madras se related bhi.

Charter Act of 1793
1) Company ke commercial privileges ko 20 saalo ke liye, renew kar diya gaya.
2) Comapany, apne kharche pure karke(Dividends, Interests, Salaries, Expenses etc),  British Sarkar ko har saal 5 lakh pounds diya karegi.
3) Governor General, Governors, Commander-in-chief ki appointment ke liye, Royal Approval Chahiye hoga.
4) Company ke senior officials ko bol diya, ki saala Khabardaar koi bina permission ke India chor ke gaya to.   Ye saale, Nepali rande chodne nikal jaya karte the.
5) Company ko power de di, licenses issue karne ki--Katto ke liye nahi chutiye,   India me trade karne ke liye, to it's employees and other Indians.
In licences ko 'Privilege' ya 'COuntry trade' bulate the, or inhi ki madad se inhone, China ko Smakiya bana diay, opium pila pilake.
6) Judiciary se Revenue Admin ko seperate kar diy, is wajas se 'Maal Adalats' band ho gayi.
7) Home Government members ko Indian revenues se tankhwa milne lagi, or ye randaap, 1919 tak chala.
Charter Act of 1813
1) 'Laissez-Faire' ki spirit me or Napolean ke Continental system se hue nuksaan ki wajah se British chode, ye demand karne lage ki saala Comapnay ko di hui monopoly ko hataya jaye.
2) Company's monopoly over trade in India was stopped except: Trade with China and Trade in Tea.
3) Company ke shareholders ko 10.5 % dividends diya gaya, India ki revenue ka.
4) 20 or saalo tak, Comapny ko possessions , Territories and revenues in India, extend kar di gayi.
(Consti. position of British Territories in India was defined explicity for the 1st time)
5) Board of Control ki powers ko or bhi enlarge kar diya gaya.
6) Indians ki education ke liye, 1 lakh rupees set aside karo
7) Councils of Madras, Bombay and Bengal ke jo bhi regulations hain, wo sab ab British Parliament ke aage rakhe jaane lage.
8) Commercial transactions or Territorial Revenues ke liye, Separate accounts bana.
9) Christian missionaries ko allow kar diya, to go and preach their religion.
Charter Act of 1833
1) Company ki lease 20 saal or extend kar di gayi.      India ki territories ko Crown ke naam par govern kiya jana tha.
2) Trade with China and Trade in Tea ko wali monopolies ko bhi hata diya gaya.
3) Europeans ke upar lage hue saare restrictions hata diye gaye, jaao or India me properites khareedo.
4) India me Financial, Legislative and Admininstrative centralisation of Government was envisaged :
i) GG ko power de di gayi to superintend, control and direct all civil and military affairs of the company.
ii) Bengal, Madras and Bomaby or baaki sab territories ko Governor-General ke complete control ke under kar diya gaya.
iii) Saare revenues, GG ke authority se collect kiye jaane lage, or GG ke pass expenditure ka bhi complete control tha.
iv) Madras or Bombay se unki legislative powers cheen li gayi.
5) GG ki council me ek Law member ko add kiya gaya, taki law-making par professional advice diya ja sake.
6) Indian laws ko codify and consolidate kiya jana tha.
7) Religion, Color, birth, descent ke basis par Kisi Indian Citizen ko employment deny nahi ki jayegi.
8) Slavery khatam karo---> It was abolished in 1843.
Charter Act of 1853.
1) Jab tak parliament kuch na bataye, tab tak territories, company ke pass hi rahengi.
2) Court of Directors ki strength ko kam karke 18 kar diya gaya.
3) Open Competitive examination for services
4) Law member, koi GG's executive council ka full member bana diya gaya.
5) 6 naye members add kiye gaye for Legislative purposes---> is se GoI ke Executive or Legislative functions ka seperation ho gaya.
6) Indian Legislature me local representation ko introduce kiya gaya.     Legislative wing ko Indian Legislative council kaga jane laga.
7) Lekin, kanoon ko GG ki assent chahiye hoti thi, or GG chahe to law ko veto bhi kar sakta tha.

Major Changes in Adminstrative Structure after 1857
New Stage of Colonialism :
- Masses ki administration se alienation kam karna jaroori tha, taaki sala dobara revolt na kar de chutiye log.
- Natives, ko administration se associate karke, rulers ko bhi natives ke baare me kaafi kuch pata chal jayega.
- 1850s ke baad se or bhi nayi colonial powers aa gayi---> Raw material, Market for mfg goods and capital investment, ke liye, cut-throat competition chal raha tha.
- Finance or Mfg goods ke trade me british supremacy khatam ho gayi thi.
- Is stage pe, kaafi large scale British Capital investment hua Indian railways or Loans to GoI.   Smaller extent me, Tea-plantations, Coal-mining, jute mills, shipping, trade or banking me bhi.
- In sab factors ke combination se start hua : New Stage of colonialism in India.

i)Article 352- Emergency due to war, external agression or Armed rebellion. ('National Emergency','Prclamation of Emergency' used for this only).

If approved, goes on for 6 months, can be extended indefinitly with Parliamentary approval every 6 months(44th Amdmt).

I)Centre can give Executive directions to states on any matter. State Govs are not suspended but are bought under complete control of Centre.

Laws made become inooperative 6 months after Emergency goes away.  Applies to all states, not just the state where Emergency has been applied(42nd Amdmt).

- Ex :Grassland ecosystems me dikhta hai. : Base Level : Ghas
2) Pyramid of Numbers : Inverted
- Highest level pe max
- Ex : Forest : Thode se ped : Bohot saare Birds : Or bhi jyada parasites(keede, makode) : Or bhi bohot bohot jyada Hyper Parasites(Bacteria, Viruses)
- Pyramid of Number, organism ke size ko dhyan me nahi leta hai.
- Or, kyunki har organism ko gin na namumkin sa hai, isliye---> Does not completely define the trophic structure of an ecosystem.
Pyramid of Biomass : Individuals ko gina nahi, balki unka weight liya jata hai. ---> Total dry weight of all organisms at each trophic level at a particular time.
- Size difference problem overcome karne ke liye, dry weight use karte hain ---> gram /meter squated.
Isme bhi upward ya inverted ho sakta hai
1) Upward : Jyadatar land wale ecosystems ke liye ---> large base of primary producers.
- Autotrophs, yani producers ka biomass sabse jyada hota hai.
2) Inverted : Aquatic ecosystems wale
- Kyunki, producer to nanhe se planktons hote hain, that grow and reproduce rapidly.
Pyramid of Energy : Most suitable hai--> To compare the functional role of trophic levels in an ecosystem.
- Always upward--> Large base---> Due to conservation of thermodynamics
- Ye pyramid explain karta hai : Biomagnification - Toxic subtances ki concentration increase hona at higher levels progressively
Bioaccumulation : Kaise pollutant food chain me enter karta hai.
- There is increase in concentration of pollutant from the environment to the 1st organism in a food chain.
Biomagnification : Increase in concentration.
- Iske liye jaruri hai ki pollutant : Long-Lived,  Mobile,  Soluble in fats   and   Biologically active ho.  Ex : DDT
- Inactive pollutant, biomagnify to ho sakta hai, lekin, hame nuksan nahi karega.
Dono species ko fayda : Mutualism ,    Ex : Pollination
Ek ko fayda, dusre ko aand farq nahi padta ,    Ex : Gaye ke gobar me beetle rehta hai
Competition : Dono ko nuksan
Predation and Parasitism : Ek ko fayda, dusre ko nuksan
Amensalism : Ek species ko harm,  dusra unaffected
- Bada tree, chote wali ki roshni rok le.
Neutralism : No benifit, No harm
Nitrogen Cycle :
- 16% by weights of all proteins-- Basic building block of all living tissues.
- Plant log seedha Nitrogen nahi use nahi kar sakte.  Isliye, Nitrogen Fixation ki madad se, pehle ise Ammonia, Nitrites or Nitrates me convert kiya jat hai.
- Earth par, 3 different tareeko se Nitrogen Fixation hota hai :
1) Micro-organims se :  Bacteria and Blue-Green Algae  ---> Ye, Nitrogen ko Ammonium Ions me convert kar dete hain.
- Free living nitrifying bacteria : Aerobic Azotobacter   and    Anerobic Clostridium
- Symbiotic nitrifying bacteria jo leguminous root nodule plants : Ex --> Rhizobium
- Blue-Green Algae : Ex --> Anabaena, Spirulina
- Plant log, ammonium ion ko seedha hi use kar sakte hain.
- Lekin, 2 groups of specialized bacterias - Nitrosomonas bacterias : --> Converts ammonia to nitrite ----> Further transformed into nitrate by Nitrobacter bacteria.
- In nitrates ko plant log kheench lete hain soil se, and convert them into amino acids---> Building blocks of proteins.
- Soil nitrates, paani me highly soluble hote hain---> Transported away by surface or ground water.
- Soils or Oceans me -- Special denitrifying bacterias hote hain--> Pseudomonas ---> Ye, Nitrates/Nitrites ko elemental Nitrogen me convert kar dete hain.
- Ye Nitrogen fir, atmosphere me dobara vileen ho jaati hai. Or paad ki aawaj aati hai, pu pu pu pu.
2) Industrial processes ka use se : Fertilizer factories
3) Thunder and lightning jaise atmospheric phenomenon se :
Sedimentary Cycle : Phosphorous, Calcium and Magnesium, is cycle ke through circulate karte hain.
1) Phosphorous : Occurs in large amount in minerals in phosphate rocks ---> Erosion and mining activites ki wajah se, it enters the cycle.
- Lakes, me rooted and free-floating microscopic plants ki excessive growth ke peeche, yahi bhadwa involved hai.
- Main storage hai iska : Earth Crust.
- Oceans me--> It accumulates on continental shelves in form of insoluble deposits.
2) Sulphur : Iska reservoir Soil hai : Locked in organic(Coal, Oil and Peat)    and     inorganci deposits(Pyrite rock and sulphur rock) ---> In form of Sulphates,Sulphides and Organic Sulphur.
- Mostly sedimentary lekin, H2S  and  SO2,  are gaseous components.
- Sulphates ko plants keench lete hain,  and  incorporate it into sulphur-bearing amino acids, which is incorporated in the proteins of autotrophs tissue.
Ecological Succession : Ecological time scale par, directional change in vegetation
- Ye hota hai, jab a series of communities ek dusre ko replace kar deti hai, due to a large scale destruction - natural or man-made.
- Ye hota rehta hai, jabtak ek stable mature community na develop ho jaye.
- Ex ; Annual Plants ---> Perennial Plants and Grasses ----> Shrubs ----> Softwood Trees-Pines ----> Hardwood Trees
- Pehla plant jo aata hai colonise karne kisi area ko ---> Pioneer community.
- Final stage of succession --> Climax community.
- Increased productivity  ,    Shift of nurtients from reservoir,   Increased organism diversity with Increased niche development,    Gradual increase in complexities of food webs.
- Secondary succession shuru hota hia, well developed soil par, already formed at the site. ---> Relatively faster.
Autogenic Succession : Jab, community ke living inhabitants ki wajah se succession aaye.
Allogenic Succession : Jab koi outside force ki wajah se aaye.
Autotrophic Succession : In which, initially, the green plants are much greater in quantity.
Heterotrophic Succession : In which, heterotrophs are greater in quantity.
- Continets ke middle me situated areas me, Succession would occur faster.

1) Ephernerals ---> Delicate annuals,  free from xerophytic adaptations ,  Have slender stems and root systems  ,   Large flowers.
- Appear almost immediately after rain---> Develop fruits and flowers in incredibly short time and dies as soon as the surface layer of soil dries up.
2) Rain Perennials ---> Bas rainy season ke time hi jammen par dikhte hain, lekin in saalo ke, perennial under-ground stem hota hai.
- Jyadatar desi plants--> Capable hote hain, water absorb karne ke, from deep below the surface , by a well-developed root system

- Xerophilous adaptations : Reduced leaves,  Thick hairy growth,  succulence,  Wax coatings,   Thick cuticle,  Protected stomata etc  ---> Taaki transpiration kam ho sake.

Acquatic Oganisms ko classify kiya jata hai---> On the basis of their zone of occurance  and their ability to cross these zones.
1) Neuston :
- Unattached organisms, jo air-water interface par rehte hain ---> Ex : Floating plants
- Kuch organisms, jaise water strider, puri life, air-water interface ke upar hi rehte hain.
- Kuch organisms, jaise beetles and back-swimmers, iske neeche rehte hain.
2) Periphyton :
- Ye organisms, Rooted plants ki stems and leaves,  Ya fir ye, bottom mud se emerge hone wale mud se attached hokar rehte hain.
- Ex : Sessile Alage and their associated group of animals
3) Plankton : Microscopic plants like algae(Phytoplankton)  and animals like crustaceans  and  protozoans(Zooplanktons), found in all aquatic ecosystems
- Planktons jyada hil-dul nahi sakte, isliye inki movements, currents hi control karte hain
4) Nekton : Wo animals, jo swimming karte hain.
- Ye relatively large  and  powerful hote hain, kyunki inhe water currents ko overcome karna hota hai
- Insects(2 mm long) se leke, Blue Whales, sab saaale Nekton hain
5) Benthos : Water mass ke bottom par milne wale organisms
Aquatic Habitats kai zones me distributed hota hai, depending upon the penetration of sunlight.
1) Photic Zone : Upper layer of aquatic ecosystems ---> Jaha light penetrate kar jaati hai ---> Saara photosynthesis, yahi tak confined hota hai.
- Is zone ki depth, pani ki transparency par depend karti hai.
- Ya photosynthesis or respiration, dono hota hai.
- Ise euphotic zone bhi kehte hain ===> Lighted and well-mixed portion, that extends from the lake surface down to where the light level is 1% of that at the surface.
2) Aphotic Zone : Aquatic Ecosystems ki lower layers, jaha light penetration and plant growth restricted hota hai
- Yaha bas respiration hota hai.
- Ye, littoral and Photic zone ke neeche hota hai, jaha light levels is too low for phtosynthesis.
- Deep unlit region ko, Profundal ZOne kehte hain.

- Fresh water me,  iski concentration hoti hai, 0.0010 % by weight ----> Air se, 150 times kam.
- Aquatic ecosystem me air enter karti hai--> Through Air water interface and through photosynthesis.
- To quantity of DO depends upon these 2 activites.

- Jab DO, 3 to 5 ppm se kam ho jaye, tab bohot saare aquatic organisms dam tod dete hain.
- Transparency : Turbid water me light penetration nahi ho pata jis se photosyntheic activity kam ho jati hai.

Calcium carbonate ke 2 forms hoe hain "
1) Calcite : Mineral Form
- Found in the shells of Planktonic algae,  Amoeboid Protists,  Some corals,  Echinoderms and some molluscs (Oyseters etc)
- Ye kam soluble hota hai.
2) Argonite : More soluble form
- Jyadatar corals, mollusks etc me yahi hota hai.

Soil Erosin ki stages :
1) Splash Erosion - 1st stage, when Raindrops hit bare soil.
2) Sheet Erosion - Thin layer of soil ka uniform movement, us land par, jispe koi vegetation na ho.
3) Rill erosion : Jab sheet flows, kisi land surface par concentrate hona shuru ho jate hain---> Rill erosion hota hai.
- Leaves visible scouring on the landscape.
4) Gully erosion : Rill wala evolve hoke, gully me convert ho jata hai---- As duration and intensity of rain continues to increase and runoff volume continues to accelerate.
- Gully wo scoured out area hota hai, that is not crossable with tillage or grading equipment
5) Ammonification : Ammonia ka production as a result of biological decomposition of organic nitrogen compounds.
